item.title: Open-source AI paints watercolors by writing JavaScript code
item.description:
Open-source AI paints watercolors by writing JavaScript code

On 23 August Surya Narreddi posted a beautiful video of watercolour paintings generated by a language model that writes JavaScript through p5.brush, a library that adds natural drawing tools to p5.js. The video went viral fast, with over 1.5 M views at the time of writing.

🔍 Overview

  • The model generates a program of about 150 lines of JavaScript that paints the image.
  • Output is code, which can be read, edited, and re‑run; the decision behind each brushstroke is visible.
  • Style is shaped by a restriction to only ten methods of the p5.brush library.
  • The resulting paintings look loose, imperfect, and handmade, contrasting with the statistically‑average pictures of typical image models.

🛠️ How it works

  • Training data: a hand‑rated pool of reference images (initially close‑up flowers, later full compositions).
  • Reward design: uses the same framing as the original blog; three reward mixes were trained and compared.
  • Reinforcement‑learning stack: built with TRL and OpenEnv; the RL environment is provided in the repository.
  • Execution: the generated JavaScript runs in p5.js via the p5.brush library, producing the final watercolor rendering.

📦 Open implementation

  • The author reproduced the idea step‑by‑step, publishing:
    • Reference‑pool dataset
    • RL environment
    • Training scripts
    • Trained models
  • All artifacts are open‑source; once two Hugging Face Spaces are up, the entire pipeline runs with a single command.
  • The repository includes a “What I would try next” list that captures ideas not incorporated into the experiments.

💡 Why it matters

  • The project revives the early generative‑AI‑art mindset where the medium and exploration were central, echoing works such as DeepDream (2015), Edmond de Belamy (2018), and the portraits of Mario Klingemann.
  • By outputting editable code instead of a static image, the approach offers transparency and creative control.
  • The viral response (over 1.5 M views) indicates strong public interest in AI‑generated art that retains a handcrafted aesthetic.

Surya’s site notes that a full technical report is forthcoming.

#AIart #RL #OpenSource #p5js #GenerativeArt

Source: Training a coding model to paint watercolours with TRL and OpenEnv

item.title: Beyond Flat Images: Mastering Hi3DGen for Photorealistic 3D Model Creation
item.description:
🌟 Beyond Flat Images: Mastering Hi3DGen for Photorealistic 3D Model Creation

Summary: Discover how Hi3DGen is revolutionizing 3D content creation through AI-powered technology. This guide explores its unmatched capabilities for generating photorealistic 3D models from simple text prompts, making professional-grade 3D creation accessible to everyone regardless of technical expertise.

🚀 The 3D Revolution at Your Fingertips

In the rapidly evolving landscape of AI-powered creative tools, Hi3DGen stands out as a game-changer for 3D content creation. Gone are the days when creating photorealistic 3D models required extensive technical expertise and expensive software. Today, we’re witnessing a democratization of 3D creation capabilities that puts professional-grade tools in everyone’s hands.

Hi3DGen represents the cutting edge of this revolution—transforming simple text descriptions into stunning, detailed 3D models with remarkable accuracy. Whether you’re a game developer, product designer, content creator, or just curious about 3D modeling, Hi3DGen offers an accessible entry point into the world of three-dimensional digital creation.

🔍 What Makes Hi3DGen Special?

Hi3DGen isn’t just another 3D generator—it’s a comprehensive ecosystem designed to make high-quality 3D content creation accessible to everyone. Here’s what sets it apart:

𝗧𝗲𝘅𝘁-𝘁𝗼-𝟯𝗗 𝗖𝗮𝗽𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗲𝘀

Unlike traditional modeling tools that require extensive manual input, Hi3DGen can interpret natural language descriptions and transform them into detailed 3D models. Want a “rustic wooden table with metal accents and a weathered finish”? Simply type it in, and watch as the AI interprets your vision with surprising accuracy.

𝙎𝙪𝙥𝙚𝙧𝙞𝙤𝙧 𝙏𝙚𝙭𝙩𝙪𝙧𝙚 𝙌𝙪𝙖𝙡𝙞𝙩𝙮

One of the most impressive aspects of Hi3DGen is its ability to generate not just geometrically accurate models but also photorealistic textures. The system understands material properties and lighting interactions, creating surfaces that look and respond to light like their real-world counterparts. 🌈

𝘗𝘩𝘺𝘴𝘪𝘤𝘢𝘭𝘭𝘺 𝘈𝘤𝘤𝘶𝘳𝘢𝘵𝘦 𝘔𝘰𝘥𝘦𝘭𝘴

The platform doesn’t just create visually appealing models—it creates structurally sound ones. This means objects generated through Hi3DGen can potentially be used for simulations, game physics, or even manufacturing applications without extensive reworking.

🛠️ Getting Started with Hi3DGen

Setting up Hi3DGen is surprisingly straightforward, making it accessible even to those with minimal technical background:

  1. Access the Platform 🔑 Visit the official interface through Hugging Face or other supported platforms. The web-based interface eliminates the need for heavy software installation.

  2. Craft Your Prompt ✨ The magic begins with your description. Be specific and detailed about what you want to create. For example, instead of “a chair,” try “a mid-century modern armchair with walnut frame and cream upholstery.”

  3. Fine-tune Parameters 🎛️ Hi3DGen allows you to adjust various generation parameters:

    • Resolution quality (higher for more detail)
    • Generation steps (more steps = more refined results)
    • Style guidance (how closely to follow artistic references)

  4. Export & Use 📤 Once generated, your 3D models can be exported in standard formats compatible with major 3D software including Blender, Maya, and Unity. This seamless workflow integration makes Hi3DGen particularly valuable for professional pipelines.

💡 Practical Applications & Use Cases

The versatility of Hi3DGen makes it valuable across numerous fields:

𝗚𝗮𝗺𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗽𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 🎮

Indie developers can rapidly prototype environments and objects without dedicated 3D artists. A game developer could generate an entire medieval village’s worth of props in hours rather than weeks.

𝙋𝙧𝙤𝙙𝙪𝙘𝙩 𝙑𝙞𝙨𝙪𝙖𝙡𝙞𝙯𝙖𝙩𝙞𝙤𝙣 📱

Product designers can quickly visualize concepts and iterations without waiting for physical prototypes. Imagine generating dozens of variations for a new chair design in minutes rather than days.

𝑉𝑖𝑟𝑡𝑢𝑎𝑙 𝑃𝑟𝑜𝑑𝑢𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 🎬

Film and animation studios can use Hi3DGen to create background assets and props that would otherwise require significant modeling resources. This democratizes high-quality production capabilities for smaller studios.

𝘈𝘳𝘤𝘩𝘪𝘵𝘦𝘤𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘢𝘭 𝘝𝘪𝘴𝘶𝘢𝘭𝘪𝘻𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯 🏙️

Architects can rapidly generate furniture, decorative elements, and even structural components to populate their digital mock-ups with realistic details.

🔮 The Future of AI-Generated 3D Content

As technologies like Hi3DGen continue to evolve, we’re witnessing just the beginning of a profound transformation in how digital 3D content is created. The implications are far-reaching:

  • Democratized Creation: Complex 3D modeling is no longer restricted to those with years of technical training
  • Accelerated Workflows: Tasks that once took days can now be completed in minutes
  • Creative Exploration: Designers can explore more iterations and concepts in less time
  • Industry Disruption: Traditional 3D modeling workflows may need to evolve as AI-generated content becomes more prevalent

Looking ahead, we can expect these tools to become even more sophisticated, with improvements in physical accuracy, animation capabilities, and integration with other creative workflows. The boundary between imagination and digital realization continues to blur at an astonishing pace.

🤔 Final Thoughts

Hi3DGen represents a fascinating intersection of artificial intelligence, computer graphics, and creative tools. While it won’t replace human creativity and artistic judgment, it dramatically lowers the technical barriers to bringing 3D ideas to life.

As with any powerful creative technology, the most exciting applications will come from how creators combine these new capabilities with their unique vision and expertise. What could you create if technical limitations were removed from your creative process?
